steps._comment: No config needed -- http_download reads response.value from get-package-url's output automatically.
azure_blob reads download-package's base64 output automatically, same as it does for an sftp download.

sourceContainer/sourceBlobName here must match stage-package-blob's container/blobName above -- blob_archive reads its own source location directly, it does not chain through upstream output (a zip maps to many destination blobs, so it owns its own blob I/O).
